subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks become a supported public owner of current-session reset requests, with the scoped deferred contract proposed here?
rationale: This is a new plugin capability with session-lifecycle authority; code review can validate confinement, but only an owner can confirm that hook-driven reset policy is a permanent supported contract rather than context-engine or core policy.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped API
options.body: Approve the current-session-only deferred API after public contract documentation, direct Codex-source verification, and complete live lifecycle proof are added.

options.title: Keep reset policy owner-controlled
options.body: Withhold the hook API and implement the recovery decision inside the owning context engine or core compaction policy instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session-only deferred API after public contract documentation, direct Codex-source verification, and complete live lifecycle proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to the shared plugin hook-contract surface where the API is being added.
